text:
Selenium is an element in Group VI.
Group VI elements follow similar trends to Group VII elements.
Which statement about selenium is correct?
A
It has a higher density than sulfur.
B
It has a lower melting point than sulfur.
C
It has six electron shells.
D
It is a monoatomic element.

options.label: A
options.text: It has a higher density than sulfur.

options.label: B
options.text: It has a lower melting point than sulfur.
